title: Airport Explorer
description: Pick a Japan airport from a dropdown to fly the map there and highlight its outline, with an option to show or hide airport outlines.

title: Airport Layer Filter
description: Filters airport locations shown as colored circles by importance, with an option to toggle an airport-runway layer on the base map.

title: Japan Airports OSM
description: Shows Japan's civilian and military airports on the map, with a dropdown to fly to and highlight any airport.

title: Building Heatmap
description: A side-by-side map comparison showing buildings colored and filtered by height, useful for visually comparing two states of the same data.

title: POI Category Search
description: Lets you search for places using Mapbox's Search Box API three ways — browsing nested categories, typing an autocomplete suggestion, or a plain text search — each with optional category filters.

title: Cell Coverage Map
description: Shows a custom map style with a cell-coverage legend and a frame-rate meter; the search and click-to-query features shown in the code are not currently active.

title: Cluster (GeoJSON)
description: Groups nearby port locations into clusters that show a count, and zoom in to break a cluster apart; clicking a port shows its details in a table.

title: Cluster (MTS)
description: The same port-clustering view as the GeoJSON version, but backed by a tileset hosted with Mapbox Tiling Service (MTS) — useful for showing how clustering scales with larger, pre-processed datasets.

title: Deliveries
description: Pick a travel time and mode, and Mapbox's Isochrone API draws a reachable area around each delivery center — delivery points then get colored by which center can reach them in time.

title: TV POI Details Search
description: Browse places by category using Mapbox's Search Box API, then pull richer details for a selected place via the Mapbox Details API.

title: DHL Capabilities - Mapbox GL JS
description: Tracks delivery vehicles along their route with live ETAs using Mapbox's Directions API, and shows how Map Matching snaps noisy GPS points back onto the road so vehicles never appear to drift off it.

title: Directions Comparison - Mapbox vs Google
description: Compares driving routes from Mapbox's Directions API against Google's routing side by side, with options to avoid certain road types and see traffic congestion colored on the route.

title: Dynamic Style — Label Language
description: Toggle between English and Japanese place names on the map without reloading it.

title: Submit Feedback - Mapbox Feedback API
description: Lets someone report an issue with the map at a specific location — picked by clicking the map, entering coordinates, or using their current location — and submits it through Mapbox's Feedback API.

title: Mapbox Feedback API - Data Table View
description: A dashboard for reviewing map feedback submitted through Mapbox's Feedback API — filter it, page through it, export it, and see each item's location on a map.

title: Flight Map
description: Animates a 3D airplane flying from San Francisco to London, with a scrubber to move through the flight and a camera that can orbit or chase the plane.

title: Fuzzy Geocoding
description: Looks up an address using Mapbox's Geocoding API, and automatically simplifies the address to retry the search if the exact address isn't found.

title: India Boundaries Coverage
description: Highlights administrative area boundaries across India using Mapbox Boundaries data, or falls back to a plain location search when a boundary isn't available.

title: Indoor Airports - Brazil
description: An auto-playing camera tour through 11 Brazilian airports, showing indoor floor plans using Mapbox's Indoor Map Tiles, with a day/night lighting picker.

title: Indoor Airport Navigation
description: Shows indoor floor plans at six airports using Mapbox's Indoor Map Tiles, and tracks your real GPS position on the floor plan; click any feature to see its details.

title: Indoor Airports - Search
description: Search a list of airports and fly to its indoor floor plan, shown using Mapbox's Indoor Map Tiles.

title: Indoor Map
description: Shows an indoor venue map with a floor switcher and indoor place search, using indoor mapping data from Mapxus, a Mapbox partner, layered on top of a Mapbox base map.

title: JWL Nowcast
description: Switch between Mapbox's Japan Weather Layers — current precipitation, rain and snow forecasts, wind, flood, landslide, and alert risk — and play through a timeline of conditions.

title: Language Selector — Map Labels
description: Switch the map's place and point-of-interest labels between 13 languages from a dropdown, falling back to English where a translation isn't available.

title: 3PL Handoff · Mapbox
description: A 3-step delivery checkout — an address is entered with Mapbox's address autofill, confirmed by dragging a pin to the exact drop-off point, then a handoff card with a map image is generated for the driver using Mapbox's Static Images API.

title: Lottery
description: A spinning 3D globe animation that reveals a prize tier from a lottery draw, with confetti and emoji celebration effects.

title: Map Matching
description: Click points on the map, or upload your own location data, and Mapbox's Map Matching API snaps them onto the nearest road for the travel mode you choose.

title: Mapbox AMAP
description: Shows AutoNavi (AMap) map tiles for Beijing layered on top of a Mapbox base map — an example of combining a local China map provider with Mapbox.

title: Merchants Tileset Overlay
description: A merchant locator for Tokyo — filter by category, brand, coupons, or campaigns, or search by name, to narrow down the merchant points shown on the map.

title: MPL 3D
description: Click to set a start and end point, and a 3D character walks the route between them; Mapbox's Tilequery API is used to scatter nearby 3D models — animals and plants — along the way.

title: Naurt Data Visualization
description: Compares Naurt's door and address location data (hosted as a tileset via MTS) against Mapbox's own geocoding across Japan, New Zealand, and the US, with match-rate statistics for each region.

title: Navigation Trace Visualization
description: Load a sample or your own GPS trace and compare the raw points against a device-matched version; re-run any stretch through Mapbox's Map Matching API to clean it up.

title: NEA
description: Shows Singapore's national weather data — rainfall, radar, satellite imagery, lightning, and fire hotspots — as layered map tiles, with a timeline and different map projections to switch between.

title: NOTAM Proximity
description: Plots example flight routes and airspace notice (NOTAM) zones near Singapore, and flags which routes come too close to a zone based on an adjustable distance threshold.

title: Osaka Indoor
description: Switch between a 3D outdoor view and a floor-by-floor indoor map using Mapbox's Indoor Map Tiles, with room selection and a location search box.

title: POI Map Builder - Mapbox GL JS
description: Build a custom point-of-interest map by clicking the map or entering coordinates, style the markers, add a title and legend, and export the result as an image or a reusable config file.

title: Precipitation Search
description: Plays back current and forecasted rain across Japan on a timeline; search for a destination and get a driving route with an ETA, plus a comparison of rain right now versus rain when you'd arrive.

title: Random
description: Plots points across Japan, color-coded and filterable by type, and uses Mapbox's Isochrone API to find only the points reachable within a driving time you choose.

title: Return to Route
description: Generates a driving route, simulates a vehicle going off-route, and uses Mapbox's Matrix API to rank the best ways to get back on track.

title: Rivers
description: Shows Japan's rivers as colored lines on the map, automatically labeling each visible segment with its river code — an example of displaying a large custom dataset as a hosted tileset.

title: Sapporo Medical Facilities & Airport - Mapbox GL JS
description: A tabbed showcase of medical facilities and the airport around Sapporo, with numbered markers, popups, a small overview map, and a button to export a screenshot.

title: Singapore Disaster Response
description: A mock disaster-response dashboard for Singapore — click a hazard zone or shelter to see example walking routes between them, with the fastest one highlighted.

title: Static Tiles
description: Switch the base map between Mapbox Satellite imagery and a custom style rendered as static raster tiles, and try it under 8 different map projections.

title: Store Location Comparison - Mapbox vs Google
description: Compares Mapbox and Google Maps side by side with synchronized camera movement — pick a store and both maps center on it and show its brand icon.

title: Store Locator
description: A store finder — search an address using Mapbox's Search Box API, filter by brand or amenities, and get walking or driving directions to the nearest location with the Directions API.

title: Storytelling
description: A scroll-driven story map that flies through chapters of Mapbox's company history as you scroll, with a small overview map that highlights each chapter's location.

title: Streets Extruded
description: A 3D view of downtown Singapore's buildings extruded to their real height, with sliders to change their color and transparency live.

title: Tap Payment
description: A transaction history view for a Japanese e-money card, showing nearby shops and a walking route to one of them using Mapbox's Directions API.

title: Travel Highlights 2024
description: A year-in-review trip map — animated plane, train, car, and ship icons travel leg to leg around the world, with city search powered by Mapbox's Search Box API, editable stops, and the ability to record the animation as a video.

title: Turn-by-Turn Navigation
description: A turn-by-turn navigation experience — get a route from Mapbox's Directions API, and watch your position smoothly snap to the road using Map Matching as you move.

title: Weather 3D
description: Shows current and forecasted rain across Japan on a timeline, with Mapbox's Tilequery API used to look up the exact rain intensity at any point you click, and place names shown for wherever you search.

title: Wind Speed and Particles
description: An animated wind visualization over Australia — a color-coded speed heatmap plus moving particles that follow the wind, with controls for opacity, color scale, and particle behavior.

title: Directions Comparison - OSM vs Zenrin
description: Compares driving routes from Mapbox's Directions API on two different road datasets — OpenStreetMap and Zenrin — side by side, with presets for common road issues and the option to avoid certain road types on each map.

title: Real Estate (JP)
description: Real estate listing/search map for Japan.

title: Real Estate (EN)
description: English-language version of the Japan real estate listing/search map.

title: Tokyo Movement
description: Movement/mobility data visualization for Tokyo.

title: Optimization
description: Route optimization demo for Japan.

title: Tokyo Weather
description: Weather visualization for Tokyo.

title: Tokyo News
description: News-location visualization for Tokyo.

title: Navigate Trace
description: Navigation trace visualization hosted demo for Tokyo.

title: Calculate Area
description: Tool for calculating area over drawn map regions in Japan.

title: Search Japan
description: Address/place search demo for Japan.

title: Auto Search
description: Automated search demo.

title: Fleet
description: Fleet tracking/visualization CodePen demo.

title: Nowcast
description: Weather nowcast visualization CodePen demo.

title: Global Weather
description: Global weather visualization CodePen demo.

title: Typhoon
description: Typhoon tracking visualization CodePen demo.

title: Tokushima Movement
description: Movement data visualization for Tokushima.

title: Nearest vs Bilinear
description: Comparison of nearest-neighbor vs. bilinear raster resampling.

title: Raster vs Vector
description: Comparison of raster vs. vector tile rendering.

title: 3D Route
description: 3D route animation CodePen demo.

title: Static Images Boundaries
description: Static map image demo showing boundary overlays.

title: Exclude from Directions
description: Demonstrates excluding road types/areas from Directions API routes.
